decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file with (2),(3) before the extension until an unused name, reserves names across the batch and live attachments, scopes renaming to the paste path before validation/record creation, and keeps drop/picker names verbatim; correctly leaves unscored extension/display details as guidance.

Names the live composer snapshot occurrences as the authoritative taken-name source, explains the records subscription deletes entries on any momentary empty snapshot while the attachment is live, and adds in-batch/in-flight reservations with records at most a supplementary hint.

Uses the captured x-cache HIT/age 178 response listing only v0.2.9 and renderCurrentChip(tag) to explain the stale latest label; rule compares fetched max tag against running PLUGIN_VERSION semantically — update only when remote > running, otherwise display the running version, never an older fetched tag.

Tests same-batch and cross-batch pastes with concrete expected names, a live occurrence still blocking a name when records is emptied by a transient snapshot, drop/picker name invariance, and chip cases for stale/equal and genuinely newer remote tags.

Synchronizes package.json version and the hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION in lib, runs node --check plus behavioral regressions, and explains delivery via re-install/served artifact and browser hard refresh, noting there is no host-side update endpoint and a tag/chip alone installs nothing.
